ovr-purpose: {"blocks":[{"key":"88on9","text":"This automation is responsible for generating shipment labels from CASH SAP to GLS (our external delivery partner for Austria). First it \"releases parcels in preparation\" via ZV41 and then downloads report from SAP transaction ZL011041. Then it creates adds header to this .csv. Afterwards, it read the data line by line and for each creates a JSON. These json files are then sent to GLS API and we receive a response with confirmation and base64 encoded shipping label for Zebra printer. These are uploaded to CASH network drive, where they can be printed by warehouse crew during their shift. Since this process will run multiple times a day and we also create a \"delta file\" to exclude already processed parcels.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

ovr-purpose: {"blocks":[{"key":"11ba2","text":"In Benelux we have been using a combination of OCR and RPA solutions in order to automatically process the incoming invoices of a selection of suppliers for a few years. The impact of this automated process is very large as it saves the operational colleagues a significant amount of time that no longer needs to be spent on manually processing and encoding all of these invoices in our SAP ERP environment. On top of that, the solution uses an extensive exception handling in order to guarantee that its actions are always as compliant and accurate as possible.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"ciiat","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"5lks2","text":"As a part of the integration of Intersafe suppliers in our ERP environment, a request was made whether this automated invoicing solution could be set up for a selection of high volume ISF suppliers as well. (E.g.: articles that have the same VMN but are still different due to a different size of the product, etc.).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"fdf1v","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"f57dl","text":"In order to be able to integrate these new suppliers in the scope of the robot, additional development will need to be done on the scripts. process_name__display: BNL - MKT - Pricing Purchase Price Match
ovr-purpose: {"blocks":[{"key":"7koe2","text":"Request from the local Products & Services (Marketing Department)","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"7b60u","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"8pj9d","text":"During the end of year pricing update process the local Products & Services (Marketing) department in Benelux needs to upload all the new purchase prices in SAP. The new purchase prices are stored in a local 'Purchase Price Bible', which contains roughly 25K lines. The new purchase prices need to be filled in in a 'per supplier' file. Each supplier has 2 separate files, one for all 'Core' products and one for the 'Non-core' products. This amounts to roughly 800 files that need to be completed.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"24bkr","text":"Doing this manually generates a significant workload for multiple employees. Previously this would be done by using V-Lookup / X-Lookup formulas in Excel. This would amount to multiple full working days being spent on this task by multiple employees of each separate product category. Given the repetitive nature of the actions that need to be carried out per iteration, a request was made to automate this process using RPA.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"9tsob","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"2d5ag","text":"The UiPath workflow will read an Excel file and store all unique references and their corresponding new purchase price. These lines will be stored in a virtual data table. The script will subsequently read every separate 'per supplier' .CSV file and match all lines in them with the references in the virtual data table. If a match is found, the new purchase price will be written back to the 'per supplier' file. The workflow will log how many files have been processed and it will also verify whether there were any files that didn't have a single matching line in the source data table.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"dpass","text":"Each file that is processed will be uploaded to a specific SharePoint folder using the Office 365 Integration Service activities, so that all files are saved on a location that is accessible by the local Products & Services colleagues.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"e6bd1","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"7llmu","text":"The script will be triggered periodically, but this should be limited to a few times per year given that these files will only be required during a specific part of the End of Year Pricing process (and possibly the Mid Year Pricing process).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

process_name: BNL MKT SDS Request Split - Oneshot
process_name__display: BNL MKT SDS Request Split - Oneshot
ovr-purpose: {"blocks":[{"key":"c7bq7","text":"Request from the local Products & Services (Marketing) department in Benelux. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"cjhv1","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"e4qjn","text":"In order to prepare for a mass update, requests will be sent out en masse to our (local) suppliers in order to receive an up to date copy of the Safety data sheets of all the products that are currently listed in assortment.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"e2kc2","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"ffrkd","text":"The request entails splitting consolidated data on a 'per supplier basis' and contacting the supplier to complete their file.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"370ra","text":"The consolidated file will be created by the local Products & Services department in Benelux and saved in a specific format. This main file will be split up per supplier so that the supplier can be sent a file that only contains the lines that are relevant to their product assortment. process_name: BNL - Supply - Release of Blocked invoice lines w/ Quantity discrepancies
process_name__display: BNL - Supply - Release of Blocked invoice lines w/ Quantity discrepancies
ovr-purpose: {"blocks":[{"key":"dc5g3","text":"On a periodic basis our local Demand & Supply team extracts a report from SAP containing a list of invoice lines which are currently blocked for payment in our SAP environment due to a discrepancy between the quantity on the invoice and the quantity of said purchase order line in our SAP environment.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"offset":209,"length":9,"style":"BOLD"},{"offset":241,"length":9,"style":"BOLD"}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"fhb19","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"2qol0","text":"These lines need to be checked and subsequently released in the SAP transaction 'MRBR' on a line level basis by a local Demand & Supply colleague if it is deemed \"clear for release\". Each separate line needs to be selected by specifying the correct SAP document number, the purchase order number, and the line number. The 'Quantity block' cell in the SAP table needs to be selected, the blocking reason needs to be released and the save button needs to be pressed. These actions need to be repeated for every single line that is marked \"clear for release\".","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"a58dg","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"c0cos","text":"Due to the highly repetitive nature of these actions, this process presents an interesting opportunity for an automated solution. The current build of the 'Blocked Invoices Release MRBRQ' Workflow was created in UiPath Studio. The workflow will use the Excel file containing the lines marked \"clear for release\" as source and create a data table to be used in the subsequent steps. The line details will be keyed in the MRBR transaction and the line in question will be requested. If a match was found in SAP for the line details in the XLSX file, the line will be released. If for whatever reason a match was not found in the SAP environment, a warning message will get returned.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"offset":156,"length":30,"style":"BOLD"}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"9398k","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"bms6m","text":"Each action well get repeated for every line that was marked \"clear for release\".","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"34gv8","text":"Lines that have been released will be logged in a separate tab of the file, leaving the unprocessed lines for further checks or the next batch.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

process_name__display: BNL - Supply/MKT - Release of Blocked invoice lines w/ Price discrepancies
ovr-purpose: {"blocks":[{"key":"20i2","text":"On a weekly basis our local Marketing team gets sent an Excel file, which is extracted from SAP, containing a list of invoice lines which are currently blocked for payment in our SAP environment due to a discrepancy between the price on the invoice and the price of said purchase order line in our SAP environment.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"offset":228,"length":6,"style":"BOLD"},{"offset":257,"length":6,"style":"BOLD"}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"8c5q9","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"5l5ol","text":"The Marketing Team needs to analyze this list and specify which lines are cleared for payment, locally described as \"Bon à payer, BAP\". These 'BAP' lines need to be released in the SAP transaction 'MRBR' on a line level basis by a local Demand & Supply colleague. Each separate line needs to be selected by specifying the correct SAP document number, the purchase order number, and the line number. The 'Price block' cell in the SAP table needs to be selected, the blocking reason needs to be released and the save button needs to be pressed. These actions need to be repeated for every single line that is marked \"clear for payment\".","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"an3iq","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"coeaf","text":"Due to the highly repetitive nature of these actions, this process presents an interesting opportunity for an automated solution. The line details will be keyed in the MRBR transaction and the line in question will be requested. If a match was found in SAP for the line details in the XLSX file, the line will be released. If for whatever reason a match was not found in the SAP environment, a warning message will get returned.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"offset":156,"length":39,"style":"BOLD"}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"9ie4h","text":"Each action well get repeated for every line that was marked \"clear for payment\".","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"9f4ic","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"n382","text":"Lines that have been released will be logged in a separate tab of the file, leaving the unprocessed lines for further checks or the next batch.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

process_name: BNL - MKT/Supply - ME23N - Get purchase price valid at PO Creation time
process_name__display: BNL - MKT/Supply - ME23N - Get purchase price valid at PO Creation time
process_description: {"blocks":[{"key":"ectgs","text":"Our Finance department sends a list of blocked invoices to our Marketing department for them to qualify any differences in purchasing price and to validate or reject payment. Our product managers go through the list to see whether the blocked invoice was due to the supplier using the wrong price, data being keyed in wrong in our SAP environment, etc. However, the ZL60 and ZM59 transactions give the purchasing price that is valid at the date of the report. It is possible that the purchase price has changed between the date of the Purchase Order creation and the date of the report. In order to give the product managers the actual purchasing price at the time of PO creation, an UiPath workflow will cycle through all the articles in the report and go to the ME23N transaction in SAP to fetch the purchase price valid at the time of PO creation.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
